title: Makin Island Amphibious Ready Group Deploys from San Diego
summary: The Makin Island Amphibious Ready Group quietly departed Monday from San Diego for a scheduled deployment, USNI News has learned. Big-deck amphibious warship USS Makin Island (LHD-8), the flagship of the Makin Island Amphibious Ready Group, was sighted sailing under the Coronado Bridge on its way out to the Pacific after 1 p.m. Monday local time. That same day, amphibious transport docks USS Anchorage (LPD-23) and USS John P. Murtha (LPD-26) also deployed from San Diego. A Navy official confirmed to USNI News that the amphibious ships had deployed. The three ships make up the Makin Island Amphibious Ready Group.
author: Caitlyn Burchett
